name: frontend
summary: Pack-wide correctness wave (agents, rules, references, skills, commands, ai-patterns): a11y-scan re-baselined to WCAG 2.2 AA with the axe option-order trap documented; the PPR API Next 16 removed is gone from both streaming-ssr and references/nextjs.md; three data-fetching detector greps that never matched are fixed and re-run; ssr-safety rebuilt to the 1.10.0 pattern shape; all seven agents re-cut with anti-triggers, sibling boundaries and pack-gated cross-pack reads; 24x24 (AA) untangled from 44x44 (AAA) in target-size guidance; and a new auth-session-client pattern covers the client session lifecycle.
